title: How Figure is manufacturing robots at scale
title_candidates: Figure is spending $3.5 billion to put a robot in your home
Figure is spending $6 billion so that every home has its own robot
Figure's plan to manufacture enough robots to put one in every home
Figure locked 100,000 AI chips to make the home robot real
Figure's $3.5 billion bet that you will own a robot within a few years
caption:
Figure has committed $3.5 billion to run 100,000 AI chips on NVIDIA's newest computing platform, with plans to scale that number beyond $6 billion. That is not a research budget. It is a manufacturing bet.

The logic is straightforward: getting a robot into every home requires a massive amount of computing power to train robots that can walk into a house they have never seen before and start working immediately. The chips are what make that possible at real scale.

Most people assume home robots are still decades away. Figure's spending schedule says otherwise.
